question: Filtered water turbidity rises on one filter while the other filters stay stable and raw water quality is unchanged. Which check comes first in a structured troubleshooting sequence?

Replace the filter media in every filter on the next scheduled shutdown
Inspect that filter for media loss, uneven backwash, and valve faults
Raise the plant flow rate to flush the affected filter back to normal

optionD: Raise the plant flow rate to flush the affected filter back to normal
